column3: credential.test probes with one 16-token completion, credential.set {test} probes the candidate key in a throwaway registry and writes only on a pass, custom endpoints must be public https, provider health is in-memory and scrubbed of keys
column4: Capy checks access before connecting; a model list proves neither the key's chat access nor the endpoint path, a completion does. Health in memory costs no row per turn; losing it on eviction is acceptable since the next response refills it
column5: plugins/models/credentials.test.ts: pass and fail probes, health from a turn, a failed tested set stores nothing and keeps the previous key, echoed keys are scrubbed, http/localhost/private IP refused
